name: Trivrit Lehyam

sections.overview: Trivrit Lehyam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Trivrit Lehyam is an herbal formulation in the form of a jam which aids in treating constipation. It is also called Trivritadi lehyam and Trivrilleham.
sections.ingredients:
Trivrit (Operculina turpethum) 
 Trijata (Cinnamon, cardamom, Tej patra / Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Honey 
 Sugar 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean all the ingredients and make a water decoction of Operculina turpethum. After the decoction is made, add powdered Operculina turpethum and sugar and heat it till it attains a semisolid consistency. In the end honey is added with Trijata and combined well.
sections.dosage:
3 to 6 grams twice a day after meals. It can be taken with lukewarm water, honey or milk. 
 It can be taken in a quantity of 5 to 10 grams after dinner as a laxative.
sections.contraindications:
The dosage is different for everyone according to their digestive strengths. 
 Over dosage may cause severe diarrhea. 
 Self-medication is discouraged. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Trivrit Lehyam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam 
 Introduction 
 Trivrit Lehyam is an herbal formulation in the form of a jam which aids in treating constipation. It is also called Trivritadi lehyam and Trivrilleham. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Trivrit (Operculina turpethum) 
 Trijata (Cinnamon, cardamom, Tej patra / Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Honey 
 Sugar 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean all the ingredients and make a water decoction of Operculina turpethum. After the decoction is made, add powdered Operculina turpethum and sugar and heat it till it attains a semisolid consistency. In the end honey is added with Trijata and combined well. 
 Dosage 
 3 to 6 grams twice a day after meals. It can be taken with lukewarm water, honey or milk. 
 It can be taken in a quantity of 5 to 10 grams after dinner as a laxative. 
 Indications 
 
 Constipation 
 Cardiac ailments 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 The dosage is different for everyone according to their digestive strengths. 
 Over dosage may cause severe diarrhea. 
 Self-medication is discouraged. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
